why: Magic Shield: DS1's weaker Strong Magic Shield (same DS1 mechanism, SpEffect 1040 vs 1050). DS2's Strong Magic Shield behaviour, numbers scaled by DS1 Magic Shield / Strong Magic Shield.
Hidden Body (DS1: body nearly invisible): DS2 has no body transparency; Chameleon is its stealth sorcery (disguise as an object). Deviation: disguise instead of transparency.
Aural Decoy (DS1: a sound that lures enemies): DS2's Yearn "serves as a decoy and lures foes toward itself".

Resist Curse (DS1: resets curse buildup, registCurse -99999): no DS2 instruction clears curse buildup (Caressing Prayer / Poison Moss / Divine Blessing cure codes 0/8/5 = poison, toxic and the spell block Profound Still inflicts), so the closest DS2 effect is a timed curse resistance in DS2's own spell form 100090:4 [s, kind, value] (kind 8 = curse, the shared Cursebite rings' kind, RingPorter R3) of +40 (the -bite rule's full value) for 60 s (DS2's Perseverance, its status-resistance miracle), cast like a DS2 self-buff sorcery (Fall Control body) with Caressing Prayer's visuals. Session 11 spell11; was UNMAPPED. Deviation: a resistance window instead of an instant reset (P).

Remedy (DS1: cures poison/toxic): DS2's Caressing Prayer "removing all poison" (cure codes 0, 8, 11), cast with a sorcery self-buff body (Fall Control). Deviation: also affects nearby allies (Caressing Prayer's area).

White Dragon Breath (DS1: crystal breath in front of the caster): DS2's Focus Souls "fires a focused beam of souls". Deviation: soul beam instead of crystal breath; no DS1 anchor (school calibration).
Dark Bead (DS1: volley of 7 dark beads): DS2's Dark Hail "fires several orbs of darkness". DS2 made DS1's Dark Orb a hex, so its family is ported as hexes (DS2 rules).
Pursuers (DS1: dark masses that pursue the target): DS2's Affinity "creates a dark mass that seems to pursue its target", ported as a hex like DS2's Dark Orb.
Fire Surge (DS1: continuous short-range fire stream, sibling of DS1 Fire Whip: same cast count, same bullet family): DS2's Fire Whip behaviour, numbers by DS1 Fire Surge / Fire Whip.

Undead Rapport (DS1: a short bullet that charms an Undead into a temporary ally): DS2 has no charm or calm (none of vanilla SpEffectSpell's 38 instruction kinds turns an enemy friendly or passive; no DS2 spell or item text describes one), so the closest DS2 effect is Yearn's lure ("serves as a decoy and lures foes toward itself": foes leave the caster for it), cast as a thrown pyromancy (Fireball body: a projectile needs a throwing cast, DS1's own is a short forward bullet). Session 11 spell11; was UNMAPPED. Deviation: the foe is distracted, not turned into an ally.

Power Within (DS1: strength/stamina boost, drains HP): DS2's Sacred Oath (attack and defence boost) with a pyromancy self-cast body (Flash Sweat). Deviation: no HP drain, nearby allies also benefit, defence also rises.
Chaos Fire Whip: DS1 Fire Whip's chaos variant. DS2's Fire Whip behaviour, numbers by DS1 Chaos Fire Whip / Fire Whip (DS1's lava pools left out).
Black Flame (DS1: close-range black fire burst, like Great Combustion: same bullet layout 0.05 s / 50 m/s): DS2's Great Combustion behaviour, numbers by DS1 Black Flame / Great Combustion.
Gravelord Sword Dance (DS1: blades erupt around the caster): DS2's Wrath of the Gods (burst around the caster), numbers by DS1 / Wrath of the Gods. Deviation: force burst instead of blades.
Gravelord Greatsword Dance: as Gravelord Sword Dance.

Escape Death (DS1: lose nothing upon death, until death): DS2's death-protection state (1000:3 kind 2, Ring of Life Protection's) applied by a Guidance-like self-cast miracle. P: the state is verified in SpEffectRing only.

Karmic Justice (DS1: an explosion around the caster after taking heavy damage): DS2's Wrath of the Gods burst, numbers by DS1 Karmic Justice's explosion (bullet 12000) / Wrath of the Gods. Deviation: bursts on cast, no damage trigger.

Tranquil Walk of Peace (DS1: slows nearby enemies): DS2's Promised Walk of Peace ("created from an ancient miracle", slows walking of those nearby), cast as a miracle (Guidance body). Deviation: DS2's version also slows the caster.
Vow of Silence (DS1: no spells in the area): DS2's Profound Still "blocks the spells of nearby casters", cast as a miracle (Guidance body).

Darkmoon Blade: DS1's magic twin of Sunlight Blade (SpEffect 1080 magicAttackPower 180 vs 1070 thunderAttackPower 180). DS2's Sunlight Blade with the element switched to magic (100080:1 / 100090:2 element 2 → 1, as DS2's Magic Weapon uses 1).
